title: The Oath of the Peach Garden
content_zh:
It was a period of chaos. The Han Dynasty, which had ruled China for four hundred years, was crumbling. Eunuchs controlled the palace. Warlords carved up the provinces.
In a remote town in Zhuo County, three men gathered in a peach orchard. Liu Bei, a humble sandal-weaver descended from the imperial family, though no one believed his claim.
Beside him stood Guan Yu, a giant of a man with a magnificent beard and a face the color of ripe dates. And Zhang Fei, a butcher with a voice like thunder and a temper to match.
They lit incense and knelt under the peach blossoms. Liu Bei spoke: 'We three, though born on different days, swear to die on the same day. We pledge to serve the Han, protect the people, and restore peace.'
Thus was born the most legendary brotherhood in Chinese history. They would change the fate of a nation.
